name: Baseline_CNN
notes: Underfitting (train ~44%, val ~50%). 3-block CNN with GAP and dropout lacks capacity for 23 artistic styles. But 48.2% is 11x above random (4.3%) — learns colour and texture cues. Confirms transfer learning is needed.

name: ResNet50_Transfer
notes: Frozen base achieves 77% — the +29pp jump over baseline proves ImageNet features (edges, textures, shapes) transfer strongly to paintings. Train ≈ val: no overfitting with frozen weights.

name: ResNet50_FineTuned
notes: +4pp over frozen base. But train-val gap (~11pp: 92% train vs 81% val) signals overfitting. LR reduced from 1e-5 to 5e-6 at epoch 14.

name: EfficientNetB0_Transfer
notes: 5pp below ResNet50 frozen. B0 is a smaller model (5.3M vs 25.6M params) — likely too little capacity for 23 diverse artists.

name: EfficientNetB0_FineTuned
notes: Only +2pp from fine-tuning. Still improving at epoch 15 — could benefit from more epochs. Smaller gain than ResNet suggests the base features were already more limiting.

name: ResNet50_v2_FineTuned
notes: Phase 2: strong augmentation + label smoothing. Same 78.8% as Phase 1 — stronger augmentation made training harder (frozen val 75.9% vs 77.0%) without improving generalisation. Train-val gap increased to 12.8pp. Random crop likely destructive for paintings where composition is a style signal.

name: EfficientNetB2_FineTuned
notes: Phase 2: B2 upgrade (+2.2pp over B0). Train-val gap only 3.6pp vs ResNet's 12.8pp — B2 generalises better despite lower absolute accuracy. Confirms B0's bottleneck was capacity, not architecture.

name: Ensemble_ResNet50v2_EffNetB2
notes: Softmax averaging of ResNet50 v2 + EfficientNetB2. +1.7pp over best single model. Different architectures make complementary errors — ensemble lifts weakest artists most.
